Design Visualization – Restaurant Courtyard

ELLALIS DESIGN

Spacious courtyard, which has been turned into a key feature of the restaurant by creating an outdoor leisure environment.
 Detailed measurements and site analysis were conducted prior to concept development, resulting in a new design that combines comfort and modern aesthetics.

modules.text:
Courtyard water pipes are integrated into the wall structure.
 The flowing water starts at the upper end of the staircase platform.
 A glass cover above the stairs allows the water stream to flow visibly beneath.

The structure is built on a steel and concrete base, topped with high-durability transparent glass.
 Water flows under the glass along the steps and continues into an open water basin in the courtyard.
